## How to read this publication

- **Germany only:** results are filtered by respondents' country of work.
- **Each year stands alone:** questions are not automatically harmonised.
- **Clear counts:** submitted and partial responses are reported separately.

The 2016 export contains only United Kingdom respondents and is not included.
